title: Trigger Happy Havoc
subtitle: Hope's Peak Academy
spoilerWarning: This section discusses the premise and setting. Later-case details may contain spoilers.
premise: Makoto Naegi arrives at the prestigious Hope's Peak Academy after being selected as the Ultimate Lucky Student. He and his classmates soon discover they are trapped inside the school.

chapters.title: The academy lockdown
chapters.summary: The students learn that leaving the school is not an option and that Monokuma has established a deadly set of rules.

chapters.title: Class trials
chapters.summary: When a murder occurs, the students investigate evidence and participate in class trials to identify the culprit.

chapters.title: The larger mystery
chapters.summary: Clues scattered through the academy point toward a mystery far larger than the students first understood.

title: Goodbye Despair
subtitle: Jabberwock Island
spoilerWarning: Character motives and later revelations are spoiler-sensitive.
premise: Hajime Hinata and his classmates arrive on a tropical island for what seems to be a school trip. Their peaceful outing becomes another killing game.

chapters.title: A trip turns dangerous
chapters.summary: The students explore the island while a new set of rules and threats pushes them toward distrust.

chapters.title: Island investigations
chapters.summary: Each incident leads to an investigation and a class trial, with clues hidden throughout the island.

chapters.title: The truth behind the trip
chapters.summary: The island's strange circumstances and the students' memories become central questions.

title: Ultra Despair Girls
subtitle: Towa City
spoilerWarning: Includes broad plot information about the Warriors of Hope; later story revelations are not detailed here.
premise: Komaru Naegi escapes captivity in Towa City and meets Toko Fukawa. Together they try to survive a city where Monokumas threaten the remaining adults.

chapters.title: Escape and alliance
chapters.summary: Komaru and Toko form an uneasy partnership and learn how dangerous the city has become.

chapters.title: The Warriors of Hope
chapters.summary: The pair encounters a group of children who control Monokumas and pursue their own vision of a new world.

chapters.title: Across Towa City
chapters.summary: The journey exposes the suffering, manipulation and conflicts behind the city's uprising.

title: Killing Harmony
subtitle: The Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles
spoilerWarning: V3 is especially spoiler-sensitive. This summary avoids explaining its central late-game twists.
premise: Shuichi Saihara, Kaede Akamatsu and a new group of Ultimate students awaken inside a strange academy and are forced into a new killing game.

chapters.title: A new group
chapters.summary: The students attempt to understand their surroundings and find a way to escape the academy.

chapters.title: Cases and class trials
chapters.summary: Investigations challenge the students' trust as conflicting testimony and hidden motives come to light.

chapters.title: Questions about reality
chapters.summary: The game's mysteries expand beyond individual cases, challenging what the students believe about their situation.
